summary.intent: Land corrections to ADR 0027 (component identity by declaration and exports) discovered while building part 1 (PR 417), and coordinate the remaining stacked work via subagents.
summary.outcome: A subagent pushed the ADR corrections as PR #418 (commit f94d124f, status still Proposed, doc lint passing) and the PR body was written via gh pr edit. CI on #418 was not checked, and part 2 and the unknown-session fix are still running.

repo: ADR 0027 lives at docs/adr/0027-identify-a-component-by-its-declaration-and-exports.md and is indexed in docs/adr/README.md. The index line must stay consistent with the decision text.
Component identity has distinct purposes: answers pair by output key, while dedupe is by declaration. Core does not record declaration yet, but the oracle already dedupes that way (PR 413).
The export path starts at the export name (e.g. `default.Item` for `Menu.Item = Item` beside `export default Menu`), and readers map `default` to their import binding.
The TypeScript checker lowercases paths on macOS, so file checks must compare against the module symbol's own declaration path.
ComponentEntry keeps `exported` and `exports` until part 2 (trail #302), and `exports` is not serialized until then.
An attachment carries its own identity (`Local(name)` or `Inline(span_start)`), and nothing re-finds a mapping by display name.
Docs-only changes are validated with `just lint doc-check machete typos`.
workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output and not user authority. Claims in them should be checked against the code on main rather than the branch diff.
When a parent PR merges, stacked child branches need their base retargeted to main, or main merged in if the parent branch is deleted.
PR bodies were written through a heredoc into $TMPDIR and applied with `gh pr edit --body-file`.
Line references in ADRs go stale, so file names are preferred.

friction: The first push of the ADR branch timed out on the network, and a retry succeeded.
PR #417 merged while the part 2 worker was stacked on its branch, so the base needs retargeting and this was not confirmed.
The subagent did not run cargo, the oracle, or wait on CI, so verification of #418 is lint-only.
open_items: Check CI on #418 and get the user's read of ADR 0027 before moving it from Proposed.
Confirm the part 2 worker (trail #302) rebased or retargeted onto main after #417 merged.
The unknown-session fix (trail #304) is still running.
PR #396 (version packages) still needs the user's review.
The user must decide the first-answer and watch budget, which gates S7 and S8.
Declaration-based dedupe is not yet recorded in core, so the ADR describes it as oracle-only for now.
